usage.finalMessage:
I added the `fee <appointment>` command. `help` and the README now list it directly after `cancel`, and all 7 tests pass under `dotnet test Clinic.slnx`.
One open question: DEC-C09 doesn't say what happens when a clinician has no listed fee (e.g. k2). The old code charged 0 for them; `fee` now refuses with `error: no visit fee listed for k2`, which is my assumption and needs Finance to confirm. Also, fees are typed into the code by hand, so any change to `docs/visit-fees.md` needs a matching code change.
The report is in `.work/report.json` and everything is committed.
